questions.q: Select the antonym of the word 'Dearth'.
questions.x: 'Dearth' is the opposite of 'Abundance'. The other options are similar in meaning to 'Dearth'.

questions.q: Choose the one word that can be substituted for: 'Rule by a few powerful people'
questions.x: 'Oligarchy' means rule by a few powerful people.

questions.q:
Identify the segment of the sentence that contains a grammatical error. If the sentence is correct, choose 'No error'.
Physics and Chemistry / is / compulsory subjects.
questions.x: The error is in part (b): 'is'. Two subjects joined by 'and': 'are'.

questions.q:
Identify the segment of the sentence that contains a grammatical error. If the sentence is correct, choose 'No error'.
Let you and I / discuss the matter / in private.
questions.x: The error is in part (a): 'Let you and I'. After 'let', use object pronouns: 'Let you and me'.

questions.q: Choose the option that best expresses the meaning of the idiom: 'The ball is in your court'
o: It is your turn to take action or decide
questions.x: 'The ball is in your court' means: it is your turn to take action or decide.

questions.q: Choose the word that is most nearly SAME in meaning to: INSIPID
questions.x: 'Insipid' means dull. 'Lively' is close to its opposite; the others are unrelated or look-alike words.

questions.q: Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to: AUGMENT
questions.x: 'Augment' is the opposite of 'Diminish'. The other options are similar in meaning to 'Augment'.

questions.q: Select the synonym of the word 'Inundate'.
questions.x: 'Inundate' means flood. 'Drain' is close to its opposite; the others are unrelated or look-alike words.

questions.q: Choose the option that best expresses the meaning of the idiom: 'To bite the bullet'
o: To face a difficult situation bravely
questions.x: 'To bite the bullet' means: to face a difficult situation bravely.

questions.q: Choose the word that is most nearly SAME in meaning to: MITIGATE
questions.x: 'Mitigate' means alleviate. 'Aggravate' is close to its opposite; the others are unrelated or look-alike words.

questions.q: What does 'carrying capacity' mean in the passage?
o: The number of hotels in a village
The number of visitors a place can absorb without damage
The weight a vehicle can carry
questions.x: Answer: 'The number of visitors a place can absorb without damage'. The passage defines it directly. The other options either add ideas not found in the passage or contradict it.
questions.p: Tourism can sustain a mountain village or overwhelm it. Homestays bring income directly to families and preserve local architecture, while unplanned hotels strain water supply and pile up garbage. The difference lies in carrying capacity — the number of visitors a place can absorb without damage. Villages that set limits, collect fees for waste management and train local guides keep both their beauty and their visitors.

questions.q: Which practice is mentioned as helping villages manage tourism?
o: Setting limits and collecting fees for waste management
questions.x: Answer: 'Setting limits and collecting fees for waste management'. The final sentence lists these practices. The other options either add ideas not found in the passage or contradict it.
questions.p: Tourism can sustain a mountain village or overwhelm it. questions.q: Who was the Viceroy of India at the time of the Morley–Minto Reforms (1909)?
questions.x: Lord Minto II was Viceroy during the Morley–Minto Reforms (1909).

questions.q: The Regulating Act of 1773 made the Governor of Bengal the Governor-General of Bengal. The first to hold this title was:
questions.x: Correct answer: Warren Hastings. The Act also established a Supreme Court at Calcutta (1774).

questions.q: Who coined the slogan 'Inquilab Zindabad'?
questions.x: Correct answer: Maulana Hasrat Mohani. Bhagat Singh popularised it in the 1920s.

questions.q: The book 'Gita Rahasya' was written by:
questions.x: 'Gita Rahasya' was written by Bal Gangadhar Tilak.

questions.q: The Kheda Satyagraha and the Ahmedabad mill strike took place — this happened in the year:
questions.x: The Kheda Satyagraha and the Ahmedabad mill strike took place in 1918. Fix this date on your 1857–1947 timeline along with the events immediately before and after it.

questions.q:
In which year did the following take place?
The August Offer was made by Viceroy Linlithgow.
questions.x: The August Offer was made by Viceroy Linlithgow in 1940. Fix this date on your 1857–1947 timeline along with the events immediately before and after it.

questions.q: Who led the salt satyagraha on the east coast at Vedaranyam?
questions.x: Correct answer: C. Rajagopalachari. He marched from Tiruchirappalli to Vedaranyam (Tamil Nadu).

questions.q: The trio 'Lal–Bal–Pal' refers to:
o: Lal Mohan Ghosh, Bal Krishna and Pal
Lal Bahadur Shastri, Balwant Rai and Pal
Lala Har Dayal, Balraj Sahni and Pal
Lala Lajpat Rai, Bal Gangadhar Tilak and Bipin Chandra Pal
questions.x: Correct answer: Lala Lajpat Rai, Bal Gangadhar Tilak and Bipin Chandra Pal. They were prominent Extremist leaders.

questions.q: Henry Louis Vivian Derozio is associated with the founding of:
questions.x: Henry Louis Vivian Derozio founded the Young Bengal Movement.

questions.q: The 'safety valve' theory regarding the founding of the Congress suggests that:
o: Hume founded it to provide an outlet for rising discontent and prevent revolt
The British opposed it from the start
It was founded to support Partition
The Congress was founded by revolutionaries
questions.x: The theory, based on Hume's correspondence, is contested by historians such as Bipan Chandra.

questions.q: The year 2023 was declared by the UN, on India's proposal, as the International Year of:
questions.x: Millets are promoted as 'Shree Anna'.

questions.q: Which country became NATO's 32nd member in March 2024?
questions.x: Correct answer: Sweden. Finland had joined in April 2023 as the 31st member.

questions.q: ISRO's SpaDeX mission successfully demonstrated in January 2025:
questions.x: Correct answer: In-space docking of two satellites. India became the fourth country to achieve space docking.

questions.q: 'Bharat Mandapam' in New Delhi is:
o: An international exhibition and convention centre that hosted the G20 Summit
questions.x: Correct answer: An international exhibition and convention centre that hosted the G20 Summit. It was redeveloped at Pragati Maidan.

questions.q: Which of the following organisations is headquartered in Vienna?
questions.x: OPEC is based in Vienna.

questions.q: India was declared free of which disease by the WHO in 2014?
questions.x: Correct answer: Polio. Smallpox was eradicated globally in 1980.

questions.q: At the 45th Chess Olympiad in Budapest (2024), India won:
o: Gold in both the open and women's sections
Silver in the open section only
questions.x: Correct answer: Gold in both the open and women's sections. It was India's first ever Olympiad gold in either section.

questions.q: World No Tobacco Day is observed on:
questions.x: World No Tobacco Day: 31 May.

questions.q: The military exercise 'Shakti' is conducted between India and:
questions.x: 'Shakti' is a bilateral exercise between India and France.

questions.q: 'Mission Vatsalya' is concerned with:
o: Child protection services and child welfare
questions.x: Correct answer: Child protection services and child welfare. It subsumes the earlier Integrated Child Protection Scheme.

questions.q: Which Article of the Constitution of India provides for: "Power of the Governor to promulgate Ordinances"?
questions.x: This subject is dealt with in Article 213.

questions.q: The 73rd Amendment requires a State Finance Commission to be constituted every:
questions.x: Correct answer: Five years. Article 243-I.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a discretionary power of the President?
o: Dismissing a ministry that has lost confidence and refuses to resign
Choosing the PM when no party has a clear majority
Returning a bill (other than a money bill) for reconsideration
Appointing Supreme Court judges by personal choice without the collegium process
questions.x: Judicial appointments follow the collegium process; the others involve situational discretion.

questions.q: The 'Zero Hour' in Parliament:
o: Is used only for Money Bills
Is an Indian innovation, not mentioned in the Rules of Procedure, starting after Question Hour
Is the first hour of every sitting
questions.x: Correct answer: Is an Indian innovation, not mentioned in the Rules of Procedure, starting after Question Hour. Members raise urgent matters without prior notice.

questions.q: The constitutional amendment that sought to establish the National Judicial Appointments Commission (later struck down) was enacted in the year:
questions.x: This was the 99th Amendment Act, 2014.

questions.q: A Governor may reserve a bill passed by the State Legislature for the consideration of:
questions.x: Article 200; a bill derogating from the powers of the High Court must be reserved.

questions.q: Fundamental Rights can be suspended during a national emergency EXCEPT those under:
questions.x: The 44th Amendment protected Articles 20 and 21 from suspension.

questions.q: The 'Objectives Resolution', which later became the basis of the Preamble, was moved in the Constituent Assembly by:
questions.x: Nehru moved it on 13 December 1946; it was adopted on 22 January 1947.

questions.q: Which Article of the Constitution of India provides for: "Provisions with respect to an Inter-State Council"?
questions.x: This subject is dealt with in Article 263.

questions.q: The Tenth Schedule (anti-defection law) does NOT apply when a member:
o: Defies the party whip without permission
Joins another party after election as an independent
Is elected Speaker and resigns from the party
questions.x: A presiding officer leaving the party on election is protected under paragraph 5.

questions.q: Six more private banks were nationalised — in which year?
questions.x: Six more private banks were nationalised in 1980.

questions.q: If the RBI wants to reduce inflation, it is most likely to:
o: Buy government securities in open market operations
questions.x: Correct answer: Raise the repo rate. Tightening reduces money supply and demand.

questions.q: The 'World Economic Outlook' is published by:
questions.x: Correct answer: International Monetary Fund. The World Bank publishes 'Global Economic Prospects'.

questions.q: 'Most Favoured Nation' treatment under WTO means:
o: A country must extend equal trade treatment to all WTO members
Special treatment for one partner only
questions.x: Exceptions include free trade agreements and special and differential treatment.

questions.q: GVA at basic prices plus product taxes minus product subsidies equals:
questions.x: Correct answer: GDP at market prices. India adopted GVA at basic prices from the 2011–12 series.

questions.q: The 'Department of Investment and Public Asset Management' (DIPAM) deals with:
o: Disinvestment and management of government equity in CPSEs
questions.x: Correct answer: Disinvestment and management of government equity in CPSEs. It is under the Ministry of Finance.

questions.q: The Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) is the share of a bank's net demand and time liabilities that must be kept:
o: As cash in the bank's own vaults only
As cash balance with the RBI
questions.x: Banks earn no interest on CRR balances. SLR is maintained in liquid assets such as government securities.

questions.q: SDG 8 relates to:
questions.x: SDG 1 is no poverty, SDG 2 zero hunger, SDG 4 quality education, SDG 13 climate action.

questions.q: If the price of a good rises by 10% and quantity demanded falls by 20%, the price elasticity of demand is:
questions.x: Correct answer: 2 (elastic). Elasticity = % change in quantity ÷ % change in price = 20/10 = 2.

questions.q: A fixed deposit pays 12% per annum while inflation is 5%. Using the Fisher approximation, the real rate of interest is about:
questions.x:
Fisher approximation: real rate ≈ nominal rate − inflation = 12 − 5 = 7%.
(Exact: (1.12/1.05 − 1) × 100 ≈ 6.67%.)

questions.q: Depletion is a method of charging the cost of:
o: Wasting assets such as mines and quarries
questions.x: Correct answer: Wasting assets such as mines and quarries. Depletion is based on the quantity extracted.

questions.q: Machinery purchased on credit from Sharma Ltd. is recorded as:
o: Purchases A/c Dr. To Sharma Ltd. A/c
Machinery A/c Dr. To Cash A/c
Machinery A/c Dr. To Sharma Ltd. A/c
Sharma Ltd. A/c Dr. To Machinery A/c
questions.x: Correct answer: Machinery A/c Dr. To Sharma Ltd. A/c. Machinery (real) comes in; Sharma Ltd. is the giver (creditor).

questions.q: The cash book serves as:
o: Only a book of original entry
Both a book of original entry and a ledger account
questions.x: Cash and bank accounts are not separately maintained in the ledger when a cash book is kept.

questions.q: Opening inventory is ₹85,000, closing inventory is ₹25,000 and cost of goods sold for the year is ₹5,50,000. The inventory turnover ratio is:
questions.x:
Average inventory = (85,000 + 25,000) / 2 = ₹55,000.
Inventory turnover = COGS / Average inventory = 5,50,000 / 55,000 = 10 times.

questions.q: A partner withdrew ₹4,000 at the beginning of every month during the year. Interest on drawings is charged at 10% p.a. The interest on drawings is:
questions.x:
Total drawings = 12 × 4,000 = ₹48,000.
Average period for monthly drawings made at the beginning of each month = 6.5 months.
Interest = 48,000 × 10% × 6.5/12 = ₹2,600.

questions.q: Office salaries are debited to the:
questions.x: Correct answer: Profit and loss account. They are indirect (administrative) expenses.

questions.q: Purchases during a month: 1st — 150 units @ ₹14; 10th — 150 units @ ₹17; 20th — 200 units @ ₹19. 450 units were issued on the 25th. Value of closing stock under FIFO is:
questions.x: Under FIFO the earliest units are issued first, so the 50 units left come from the latest purchases: 50 × ₹19 = ₹950.

questions.q: From the following, compute Gross Profit: Opening stock ₹35,000; Purchases ₹3,40,000; Purchase returns ₹2,000; Carriage inwards ₹3,000; Sales ₹3,81,000; Closing stock ₹25,000.
questions.x:
Cost of goods sold = Opening stock + Purchases − Purchase returns + Carriage inwards − Closing stock
= 35,000 + 3,40,000 − 2,000 + 3,000 − 25,000 = ₹3,51,000.
Gross profit = Net sales − COGS = 3,81,000 − 3,51,000 = ₹30,000.
Carriage inwards is a direct expense (Trading A/c).

questions.q: Machinery costing ₹80,000 is depreciated at 10% per annum on the Written Down Value method. Its book value at the end of 2 years will be:
questions.x:
WDV: depreciation each year is charged on the opening book value.
Book value = Cost × (1 − r)ⁿ = 80,000 × (0.9)^2 = ₹64,800.
(SLM at the same rate would give ₹64,000.)

questions.q: The current ratio of a company is 1.75 : 1 and its working capital is ₹1,01,250. Its current assets amount to:
questions.x:
Let current liabilities = x. Then current assets = 1.75x and working capital = 1.75x − x = 0.75x.
0.75x = 1,01,250 → x = ₹1,35,000.
Current assets = 1.75 × 1,35,000 = ₹2,36,250.

questions.q: Interest credited by the bank but not yet recorded in the cash book makes the:
o: Pass book balance higher than the cash book balance
questions.x: The bank has credited the account; the business will record it after seeing the statement.

questions.q: Which body issues Accounting Standards (AS) and the Ind AS drafts in India?
o: Accounting Standards Board of the ICAI (notified by the Central Government on NFRA's recommendation)
questions.x: The ICAI's ASB formulates standards; the Central Government notifies them for companies after NFRA's recommendation.

questions.q: Ind AS 1 deals with:
questions.x: Ind AS 1 sets out the overall requirements for presentation of financial statements.

questions.q: A firm has Cash ₹35,000, Debtors ₹35,000, Inventory ₹30,000, Prepaid expenses ₹7,500, Creditors ₹80,000, Bills payable ₹5,000 and Outstanding expenses ₹7,500. Its current ratio is:
'Job evaluation' is a systematic process to determine:
o: The performance of an individual employee
The relative worth of jobs within an organisation for fixing pay
questions.x: Correct answer: The relative worth of jobs within an organisation for fixing pay. Methods include ranking, grading, point rating and factor comparison.

questions.q: A contractor deploys 45 contract workers in a factory. Under the OSH Code, the contract labour licensing provisions:
o: Do not apply, since the threshold is 50 contract workers
Apply only if workers are women
questions.x: The OSH Code raised the threshold for contract labour provisions to 50.

questions.q: Under the IR Code, the National Industrial Tribunal is constituted by:
questions.x: The Centre constitutes National Industrial Tribunals for disputes of national importance or affecting establishments in more than one State.

questions.q: In the Code on Wages, the four skill categories used for fixing minimum wages are unskilled, semi-skilled, skilled and:
questions.x: The Code recognises four categories: unskilled, semi-skilled, skilled and highly skilled.

questions.q: The 'triple test' for determining whether an activity is an 'industry' was laid down in:
o: Bangalore Water Supply and Sewerage Board v. A. Rajappa (1978)
Excel Wear v. Union of India (1978)
Olga Tellis v. Bombay Municipal Corporation (1985)
questions.x: A seven-judge bench (Justice Krishna Iyer) held that systematic activity, co-operation between employer and employee, and production of goods/services to satisfy human wants make an activity an 'industry'.

questions.q: The Eighth Central Pay Commission, approved by the Union Cabinet in January 2025, is chaired by:
questions.x: The Government notified the 8th CPC with Justice (retd.) Ranjana Prakash Desai as chairperson in 2025.

questions.q: Unemployment arising from a mismatch between the skills of workers and the requirements of available jobs is called:
questions.x: Structural unemployment results from changes in the structure of the economy and skill mismatches.

questions.q: The Ahmedabad Textile Labour Association (Majoor Mahajan Sangh), 1920, was inspired by:
questions.x: It followed the 1918 Ahmedabad mill strike in which Gandhi undertook his first hunger strike in India; Anasuya Sarabhai led it.

questions.q: Under the Payment of Gratuity Act, the continuous service requirement of five years does NOT apply when employment ends due to:
questions.x: The five-year condition is waived for termination due to death or disablement.

questions.q: The Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act, 2017 made a creche facility mandatory for establishments with at least:
questions.x: Establishments with 50 or more employees must provide a creche within a prescribed distance; mothers may visit it four times a day.

questions.q: Under the OSH Code, the provisions relating to contract labour apply to establishments or contractors employing at least:
questions.x: The threshold was raised from 20 (under the Contract Labour Act, 1970) to 50 contract workers.

questions.q: Under the IR Code, disputes between trade unions (inter- or intra-union) are adjudicated by:
o: The Registrar of Trade Unions only
questions.x: The IR Code empowers Industrial Tribunals to adjudicate disputes among trade unions, besides the Registrar's role in registration.

questions.q: 'Collective bargaining' is best described as:
o: Negotiation between employers and organised workers to determine terms and conditions of employment
questions.x: It is the process of negotiation between an employer (or association) and workers' representatives.

questions.q: The 'Labour Welfare Fund' for beedi, cine and certain mine workers was financed historically through:
o: Cess on production/sale of goods (welfare cess laws)
questions.x: Cess-based welfare funds financed health, housing and education for these workers; the cess laws were later repealed and merged under GST.

questions.q: A 'Social Security Agreement' (SSA) between India and another country mainly helps Indian professionals working abroad by:
o: Avoiding double social security contributions and allowing export/totalisation of benefits
Exempting them from income tax abroad
Giving them free health insurance in India
questions.x: SSAs provide detachment (exemption from host-country contributions for short postings), exportability and totalisation of contribution periods. EPFO is the operating agency for India.

questions.q: ILO Convention No. 102 (1952) is concerned with:
questions.x: C102 sets minimum standards for nine branches of social security; it is the flagship social security convention.

questions.q: The employer's contribution to the EDLI Scheme is:
questions.x: Correct answer: 0.5% of wages up to ₹15,000. Employers pay 0.5% of wages to EDLI; employees do not contribute.

questions.q: Temporary disablement benefit under ESI is payable at what rate of wages as long as the disability lasts?
questions.x: Temporary disablement benefit is 90% of wages from day one for employment injury.

questions.q: A woman employee entitled to 26 weeks of maternity benefit has an average daily wage of ₹320. Following the Supreme Court's view in B. Shah v. Presiding Officer (1977) that the benefit covers all days of the period, the total maternity benefit is:
questions.x:
The benefit is paid for every day of the 26-week period including Sundays: 26 × 7 = 182 days.
Amount = ₹320 × 182 = ₹58,240. (Using 6 days/week would wrongly give ₹49,920.)

questions.q: In NPS, the account that is a voluntary savings facility with flexible withdrawals is:
questions.x: Tier I is the pension account with restricted withdrawals; Tier II is an optional savings account.

questions.q: In social security terminology, 'contingency' refers to:
o: A financial emergency fund of the government
An event such as sickness, old age, maternity, injury or death that interrupts income
questions.x: Social security protects against contingencies that cause loss or reduction of income.

questions.q: The 'Longitudinal Ageing Study in India' (LASI) provides data mainly on:
o: Health, economic and social well-being of India's population aged 45 and above
questions.x: LASI, led by the Ministry of Health with IIPS, is one of the largest ageing surveys in the world.

questions.q: Under the Code on Social Security, fixed-term employees get gratuity:
o: On a pro-rata basis if they render at least one year of service
questions.x: Pro-rata gratuity is available to fixed-term employees after one year.

questions.q: Under EPF, 'employee' includes a person engaged through a contractor in or in connection with the work of the establishment. Hence the principal employer:
o: Is liable to ensure PF contributions of contract workers if the contractor defaults
Has no liability for contract workers
Pays only the employer's share for contract workers
questions.x: The principal employer may recover from the contractor amounts it pays for contract employees.

questions.q: The EDLI assurance benefit is calculated as a multiple of average monthly wages plus a bonus. The multiple is:
questions.x: Benefit = 35 × average monthly wages (last 12 months, capped at ₹15,000) + bonus (up to ₹1.75 lakh) linked to the average PF balance.

questions.q: Under Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (2014), RuPay debit card holders (accounts opened after 28 August 2018) get accident insurance cover of:
questions.x: Accident cover was raised from ₹1 lakh to ₹2 lakh for accounts opened after 28 August 2018.

questions.q: Under the Employees' Pension Scheme, 1995, a member retires at 58 with pensionable salary of ₹15,000 and pensionable service of 20 years (including any weightage). The monthly member pension is:
questions.x:
Monthly pension = (Pensionable salary × Pensionable service) / 70
= (15,000 × 20) / 70 = ₹4,286.
Pensionable salary is the average of the last 60 months' wages (subject to the ₹15,000 ceiling), and the minimum pension is ₹1,000.

questions.q: India's first National Policy on Older Persons was announced in:
questions.x: The 1999 policy envisaged financial security, health care, shelter and welfare for the elderly.

questions.q: In MS Word, the feature that automatically corrects common spelling mistakes as you type is:
questions.x: Correct answer: AutoCorrect. Mail Merge creates personalised letters from a data source.

questions.q: Human beings have how many pairs of chromosomes?
questions.x: That is 46 chromosomes in total; the 23rd pair determines sex.

questions.q: The weight of an object on the Moon compared with the Earth is about:
questions.x: Correct answer: One-sixth. Mass remains the same; weight depends on gravity.

questions.q: Which disease is caused by the deficiency of iodine in the diet and was tackled through iodised salt?
questions.x: The National Iodine Deficiency Disorders Control Programme promotes iodised salt.

questions.q: In MS Excel, the intersection of a row and a column is called a:
questions.x: A cell address combines column letter and row number, e.g., B4.

questions.q: Which planet is known as the 'Red Planet'?
questions.x: Correct answer: Mars. Iron oxide on its surface gives the red colour.

questions.q: Which gates are called 'universal gates'?
questions.x: Correct answer: NAND and NOR. Any logic circuit can be built using only NAND or only NOR gates.

questions.q: 'Machine learning' is a branch of:
o: Artificial intelligence that enables systems to learn from data
questions.x: Correct answer: Artificial intelligence that enables systems to learn from data. Deep learning uses multi-layer neural networks.

questions.q: A computer 'virus' is:
o: A malicious program that attaches to files and spreads
questions.x: Correct answer: A malicious program that attaches to files and spreads. Antivirus software detects and removes malware.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. Viruses can be treated with antibiotics.
2. Vaccines can prevent some viral diseases.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.x:
Statement 1 is incorrect; Statement 2 is correct.
Antibiotics act on bacteria, not viruses.

questions.q: Rusting of iron requires the presence of:
questions.x: Correct answer: Both oxygen (air) and water (moisture). Rust is hydrated iron(III) oxide.

questions.q: Atomic nucleus (gold foil experiment) is credited to:
questions.x: Atomic nucleus (gold foil experiment): Ernest Rutherford.

questions.q: In what ratio must sugar costing ₹50 per kg be mixed with sugar costing ₹130 per kg so that the mixture is worth ₹55 per kg?
questions.x:
Alligation: (dearer − mean) : (mean − cheaper) = (130 − 55) : (55 − 50) = 75 : 5 = 15 : 1.
This is cheaper : dearer.

questions.q: Find the median of the weekly overtime hours: 82, 92, 42, 57, 24, 45, 56, 35.
questions.x:
Arrange in order: 24, 35, 42, 45, 56, 57, 82, 92.
n = 8 (even) → median = average of the 4th and 5th values = (45 + 56)/2 = 50.5.

questions.q: What is the remainder when 584 × 405 × 311 is divided by 13?
There are 61 names in a queue at a counter. Lata's name is 46th from the top. What is its position from the bottom?
questions.x: Position from bottom = Total − position from top + 1 = 61 − 46 + 1 = 16.

questions.q: Find the next term of the series: 3, 7, 16, 35, 74, ?
A box contains 6 red, 4 blue and 3 green tokens. Two tokens are drawn at random without replacement. What is the probability that both are red?
questions.x:
Ways to choose 2 red = C(6,2) = 15; ways to choose any 2 = C(13,2) = 78.
P = 15/78 = 5/26.

questions.q: In how many ways can the letters of the word 'TREASURY' be arranged so that all the vowels always come together?
questions.x:
Vowels: E, A, U; consonants: T, R, S, R, Y.
Treat the vowels as one block → 6 units → 360 arrangements (R appears 2 times).
Vowels inside the block: 6 ways (all letters are distinct).
Total = 360 × 6 = 2,160.

questions.q: At what time between 10 and 11 o'clock will the hands of a clock coincide?
questions.x:
At 10:00 the minute hand is 50 minute-spaces behind the hour hand.
To coincide it must gain 50 spaces; it gains 55 spaces in 60 minutes.
Time = 50 × 60/55 = 600/11 minutes = 54 6/11 minutes past 10.

questions.q:
New establishments registered — 2020: 125  |  2021: 110  |  2022: 115  |  2023: 135  |  2024: 115.
What is the percentage change from 2021 to 2023?
questions.x:
Change = 135 − 110 = 25 on a base of 110 (earlier year).
% change = 25/110 × 100 = 22.73% → 22.73% increase.

questions.q: The number of claims settled by a regional office increases by 20% in the first year and decreases by 12% in the second year. The net percentage change over the two years is:
A sum of money lent at simple interest amounts to ₹9,775 in 3 years and to ₹11,050 in 6 years. The rate of interest per annum is:
On which day of the week did 11 February 2060 fall?
questions.x:
Odd-day method (Sunday = 0).
Completed years = 2059: 2000 years → 0 odd days; 0 years → 0; remaining 59 years have 14 leap + 45 ordinary → 14×2 + 45 = 73 → 3 odd day(s).
Days elapsed in 2060 up to 11 February = 42 → 0 odd day(s).
Total = 0 + 3 + 0 = 3 → 3 → Wednesday.

questions.q: A invests ₹25,000 for the whole year and B invests ₹60,000 after 6 months. If the annual profit is ₹22,000, B's share is:
questions.x:
Profit is shared in the ratio of capital × time.
A: 25,000×12, B: 60,000×6 → 5 : 6.
B's share = 6/11 × 22,000 = ₹12,000.

questions.q: A shopkeeper marks his goods 50% above the cost price and allows a discount of 12% on the marked price. His gain or loss per cent is:
questions.x:
